1_corse:
Edit the attached real screenshot of my game MAREA (phone, portrait). Keep the same 3D low-poly pixel world: same camera, stone harbor plaza, red torii, wooden pier, palms, turquoise sea, the small avatar in the middle and the old lady NPC. REMOVE all the old UI (brown panels, fps text, the 'Primi passi' box, the CONSEGNE label) and redesign the HUD from scratch as a polished video game UI mockup. Output: vertical 9:16 phone screenshot, full bleed, no phone frame, no hands.
HUD elements, all of them and nothing else:
1. coin counter at the top: coin icon + "1250" (the only currency)
2. round minimap top-right with "N"
3. small navigator pill under the minimap: pier icon + arrow + "102 m"
4. menu of 6 icon-only buttons: book, t-shirt, camera, bell with a red notification dot, gear, smiley face. Grouped compactly, never covering the center
5. virtual joystick bottom-left; big "A" button and smaller "B" button bottom-right
6. name tag "Nonna Pina" with a speech icon over the old lady; prompt "A Parla" over the avatar
7. compact dialog card just above the controls: title "Sali in barca!" and one short line of small text
Texts exactly as written (Italian), crisp and legible on a phone. The world stays visible in the center. No logos or characters from other games.
STYLE: the same UI family as the 2nd and 3rd attached images (the already approved HUD and menu of our racing island): extra-bold rounded font like Titan One, white with a dark outline, deep blue + cyan + bright yellow, slightly slanted italic plates and cards, thick white borders, blue and white checkered details, light-blue glass panels, the A button big and yellow like the GAS button. It must look like the same game as those two images.
